primary_objective: maximize A_ITO(lambda_E) = 1 - R - T (ITO only lossy layer; volume-integral cross-validation in failure_test.json)
lambda_E_origin: frozen operating wavelength inherited from the validated finite-K bare-film ENZ branch (K = G10 of the 850-nm lattice); not a term of the loss

in_loop_gate.name: resonance-contrast gate (empirical ENZ-band spectral-selectivity surrogate; NOT a Q constraint)
in_loop_gate.center_dominance: A(lam_E) >= A(lam_E +/- d) (three-point test; not a proof of peak location)
in_loop_gate.penalty: loss = -A(lam_E) + mu*[relu(C_MIN - C)^2 + sum_pm relu((A_pm - A_E)/A_E)^2]

post_hoc_certification.pole: channel-agnostic AAA poles of r_xx and t_xx; accept only in-window, r/t-agreeing (<2%), residue >= 5% of window max, resampling-stable (<2%)
post_hoc_certification.Q_note: Q ~ 5 is an empirical trusted loaded-resonance reference scale (bare ENZ QNM 5.80, loaded poles 5.0-5.7), not a fundamental ceiling
post_hoc_certification.no_ITO_control: same geometry a-Si/glass: bare photonic pole must exist near the ENZ window; ITO loading must change the response and enhance A_ITO

design_class: NOT part of the target (padding is a geometry prior; see report section on the next run)
